source.head: 5fbfd5dff0fe37df61ac53d9a9a596cdd112b24b
source.scope: Four harness files only; products/DTO/API/dependencies/CI/specs unchanged by this commit; no canonical merge or remote write.

confirmed_original_cause.original_failure_case: tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts:7:1 actual Authoring preparation diagnoses missing proof without dispatch and learner can recover safe cancellation
confirmed_original_cause.confirmed: Vite exited before owned readiness with Port 40581 is already in use.
confirmed_original_cause.competitor_identity: UNKNOWN; no scan or process lookup performed
confirmed_original_cause.static_harness_risk: availablePort releases an ephemeral port before child bind; selected UI port is not reserved while API startup proceeds. This permits a race window but does not identify which competitor took original port.
confirmed_original_cause.scope: Test harness startup only; other Review/grading failures and original full-gate results remain separate.
confirmed_original_cause.retry_admission: Actual nonzero exited UI child plus explicit target-port EADDRINUSE/Vite bind-collision diagnostic; no retry on API/general startup failure, unknown live result or HTTP readiness failure.

behavior.retry: Exactly one retry, admitted only by a private typed collision from the already closed, nonzero, nonsignaled UI child and an explicit diagnostic for its selected port.
accepted_diagnostics: Node EADDRINUSE identifying 127.0.0.1 and selected port
Vite exact Error: Port <selected port> is already in use line
behavior.startup_deadline: One original 20_000ms deadline shared by initial API/UI readiness and retry; fetch/pause bounded by remaining time. No per-attempt reset and no global case timeout changes.
behavior.owned_ui_readiness: The owned Vite Local: http://127.0.0.1:<selected port>/ marker, with ANSI normalization, must be present before HTTP readiness is accepted; a live owned child must remain live when the response succeeds.
nonretry_failures: signal/zero exit or unknown live outcome
behavior.cleanup: AuthoringRuntime startup catches failures and closes only its retained owned API/UI/context before returning the original error; closed-child state is recorded after close/drained streams; process signals use only recorded groups created by owned().
behavior.port_race_scope: The reserve-then-close allocation window still exists; bounded handling mitigates a proven bind collision without identifying or stopping a competitor. No collision-free allocation claim.

RED.scope: A necessary helper exposes the copied original readiness/ownership behavior and one startup attempt, while the AuthoringRuntime target is still unchanged at RED. This is a deterministic real-owned-process behavior reproduction, not a test/CI run of an unmodified 68a whole checkout.

SAME_TEST_GREEN.note: The first fix passed the exact RED test file. Final bounded run below also includes that unchanged test against the final source.

coverage: actual owned EADDRINUSE then successful reselection while collider remains listening
second collision stops after two total attempts with exactly shared deadline
actual bind error in Vite diagnostic format
general exit7 retains original error and cleanup without retry
live child printing collision remains nonready and is cleaned up without retry
another owner HTTP200 is not readiness for owned child without marker
owned HTTP503 remains failure with cleanup and no retry
selected-port colored Vite-format marker plus actual HTTP readiness, despite another owner HTTP200
FINAL_BOUNDS_GREEN.scope: Pinned Node24 built-in tests using actual owned child processes and simple loopback servers; Vite-format output is generated by the ordinary Node test server, not a real Vite/product run.

risk_and_limits: Actual Vite output and AuthoringRuntime full API/UI startup were not executed in this task; root should review/integrate before such acceptance.
The original competitor process identity remains unknown; no scan, unknown-process signal, port-owner lookup, or host probe was used.

Only the Authoring owned UI bind-collision path is addressed; the three original unique browser cases/four failure occurrences remain historical facts, and Review/grading failure causes are not fixed or reclassified.
No global case budget was increased.
Product files, public DTO/API, dependencies, CI and specifications are not changed in the four-file commit.
No canonical/frozen/full-gate source tree was modified, merged, or remotely published; fixed source exists only on the new local branch/worktree.
Physical numeric, whole M6.3, M7 and full CI acceptance are not established.
